name: qfd_dv_slice_tload_ns-tldns-COMMIT
purpose: QW-F16SUB 10-19: tload structural successor (tld1/_b clock spread 105/90 ps FAIL): stream N -> joined S (bus crosses the ROMs N-S on vertical M5, never W-E over M4 blockage), ck W centre between the two pin bands. Primary: 367.2 x 237.6, fill ~37%.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_dv_slice_tload u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_slice_tload.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_table_rom_loader.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_rom_4096x266_m8/ot_rom_4096x266_m8_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_slice_tload_ns/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_slice_tload_ns/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_slice_tload_ns --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_dv_slice_tload --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_rom_4096x266_m8 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
